newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dollar rate no cause for concern-Buba's Jochimsen.
newsitem.headline: Dollar rate no cause for concern-Buba's Jochimsen.

text.p: Bundesbank board member Reimut Jochimsen said on Saturday that the current dollar-mark was not a cause for concern.

Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Friday that U.S. economic fundamentals should allow the dollar to be stronger, and German industrialists have expressed concern that the strong mark is harming German competitiveness.
But Jochimsen told journalists after a seminar that "this is an area where I don't think we need to be especially worried".
"One might wish for a higher dollar...but no one listens anyway," he said.
